Stripe and PayPal offer streamlined payment processing, but they come with severe geographic limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, effectively sidelining creators in Nigeria and many other regions. PayPal's infrastructure also poses risks, with account suspensions potentially freezing funds for up to 180 days without recourse. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions like COREMERCH provide creators with full ownership of their digital storefronts and payment processes, ensuring that they are not at the mercy of platform policies or geographical restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal simply do not serve many countries, effectively excluding a large portion of the global creator economy. This exclusion means creators are forced to look for alternative methods, which often leads to unreliable and complicated workarounds. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these limitations entirely. COREMERCH's solution allows creators in Nigeria and similar regions to set up a fully functional online store without needing approval from a traditional payment platform, thus fostering true financial independence.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Both Stripe and PayPal have varying fee structures and payment timelines that can be frustratingly opaque. Delays in payment processing can stifle cash flow, especially for creators relying on timely transactions. Sovereign commerce systems like COREMERCH utilize NOWPayments, enabling immediate crypto payment verification at a mere 0.5% fee. This not only reduces costs but also ensures that creators receive their funds quickly, allowing them to reinvest in their projects without unnecessary delays.
Sovereign infrastructure means no dependency on restrictive payment platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a crucial differentiator. With Stripe and PayPal, creators rent access to their platforms, creating dependency and risk of sudden account limitations. On the other hand, a sovereign commerce infrastructure grants full ownership of the entire digital store and customer data. Automated systems streamline product delivery and payment confirmations, ensuring that creators can focus on their content while the infrastructure handles the logistics. This level of automation is essential for scaling their businesses sustainably.

While traditional options may seem convenient, they carry inherent risks and limitations. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets.
